text:
eli: hey all, first-week question — running `docker-compose up` and postgres dies on first init with `initdb: could not change permissions of directory "/var/lib/postgresql/data": Permission denied`. i'm on an M1 Mac and using `./pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data` bind mount because i want local dumps. any quick hacks?

tara: welcome! :wave: mac binds are annoying. easiest fix is to use a named volume instead of a host mount. if you need files on host, use the chown-in-container trick.

sam: exact command we use: `docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)/pgdata":/data alpine sh -c "chown -R 999:999 /data"` then `chmod 700 pgdata` on host and `docker-compose up`. 999 is the postgres uid in official images.

eli: i tried `sudo chown` on my host but docker still complained. this container chown trick actually modifies the mount?

tara: yup. running chown from inside a root container applies to the mounted dir because the container runs as root. it's more reliable than host chown on mac.

eli: also saw weird errors about "invalid argument" from docker when creating dirs. could this be gRPC FUSE?

sam: possibly. Docker Desktop recently switched to gRPC FUSE which causes weird mount semantics. If you keep hitting strange FS errors, flip to the legacy osxfs or disable gRPC FUSE in Docker Desktop prefs.

eli: are there arch issues to watch for? i didn't set `platform:` but some compose samples do.

tara: avoid forcing `platform: linux/amd64` unless you need x86 emulation. Multi-arch postgres images exist and work on arm64. Emulation can make startup slower and sometimes break permission behavior.

dev-ops-bot: FYI: onboarding recommends use of named volumes for mac, and setting `PGDATA=/var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata` in compose to avoid strict initdb checks. See internal setup doc.

eli: thanks — switching to a named volume and running the chown-from-container trick worked. DB came up and migrations applied. saved me from a deep rabbit hole :relieved:

sam: protip: `docker-compose down -v` to remove leftover volumes if you change between host mounts and named volumes during testing.

tara: ping us in #new-hires if anything else blocks you — happy to pair.

eli: will do, appreciate it!
